info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Balances-v4-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Balance Retrieval API allows clients to access and view the loyalty balances associated with customer accounts. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can provide their customers with real-time information regarding their loyalty points, enhancing customer engagement and satisfaction. Typical use cases include mobile applications and web platforms where customers track their loyalty rewards. This API streamlines interactions and helps businesses tailor promotional offers based on customer loyalty status.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current loyalty balance of a customer. This balance is crucial for understanding the rewards available for customers and their engagement with the loyalty program.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the current loyalty balance details for a user. Ensure to include relevant user information for accurate balance retrieval.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the loyalty balance information.
